From “Are We Lost?” to “We’ll Be Back”
Jun 2026 • Couples
We came here for a midday break from the sun and a couple of cold beverages. Little did we know it would become one of our favourite stops in Hanoi.

The alleyway leading to the entrance looked ropey as hell and certainly wasn’t screaming “hidden café gem” at first glance. In fact, we were convinced for a moment that we had accidentally wandered into someone’s garage. Thankfully, the owner greeted us warmly and pointed us in the right direction.

After climbing the stairs, we arrived at a quaint little café with plenty of seating and a wonderfully relaxed atmosphere. We grabbed a spot by the window and spent some time watching the organised chaos of Hanoi traffic pass below.

For drinks, we ordered a passion fruit smoothie, a banana and chocolate smoothie, and an iced salt coffee.

The flavours were fantastic and exactly what we needed after spending the morning battling the heat and humidity. Everything was refreshing, well-made, and helped us cool down considerably. It was also nice to slow the pace for an hour and simply watch life unfold outside the window.

The atmosphere was cosy and relaxing, the owners were lovely, and the whole place felt like a hidden retreat from the busy streets below. Sometimes the best cafés are the ones that make you wonder if you’ve taken a wrong turn on the way there.

At 175,000 VND (£4.90), it was excellent value for money and somewhere we would happily return to.

A lovely hidden gem in Hanoi’s Old Quarter.

Much more than just coffee – an ecologically refreshing pearl in Hanoi!
Apr 2026 • Solo
If you’re in Hanoi looking for a place with character, Hidden Gem Coffee is just that. I’m very excited about the place’s agenda – a real concern for the environment and design that is largely based on recycled materials. Space engineering is great, and each floor has a completely different vibe, so everyone can find the corner and atmosphere that suits them at the moment.
The staff of waiters are charming, very high-quality services, and are happy to prepare and recommend dishes from the menu with a good smile and energy.
In terms of food: I ordered the vegetarian spring rolls (there is also a pork option). They were well made and very delicious. A little warning to the rushers – they arrive hot at the table, so it is recommended to wait a little to avoid getting burned. In addition, I took the lemon drink and the lemon & butterfly Pea, which was very delicious in purple color.
For dessert, I decided to leave my comfort zone and order a pasiflora mousse. Day-to-day pasiflora desserts were not my first option, but the bet was huge.
In conclusion, a place with a smart concept, careful service and great food.
